messages:
emma-cs: FYI BrightLedger reported a big drop in search/rerank quality after last night's rollout. They say citations disappeared and recall dropped on their eval set. Sharing details below.

maya-cs: Customer sent a short repro and before/after outputs. Pasting the excerpt they provided.

BrightLedger (customer): Query: "invoice reconciliation mismatch 2024-09"
Expected top doc id: doc_4721 (contains invoice table and exact match)
After rollout top doc id: doc_9812 (irrelevant policy memo).
Their eval snapshot: recall went from 86% -> 52% after 02:00 UTC deploy.

emma-cs: They also attached the API response and reranker scores. They included a curl they used for repro.

maya-cs: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieval/query \n  -d '{"query":"invoice reconciliation mismatch 2024-09","top_k":5,"index":"brightledger-prod"}'
```

dylan-eng: Assigning to eng. Can someone paste the raw response ids + any embedding norm numbers? Do we know if their index was rebuilt or if embed model changed during the rollout? @jordan-ops

sarah-ml: Quick thought: we rolled rerank-v3 to hosted at ~02:14 UTC yesterday. There was also an index rebuild job that touched BrightLedger earlier (01:50 UTC) using embed-model v2-quant. Both are suspicious.

jordan-ops: deploy-bot logs show rerank-v3 -> 100% at 02:14 UTC. infra-bot: index rebuild for brightledger completed 01:50 UTC.

lena-qa: QA smoke didn't catch this because invoice queries are a narrow slice not in our smoke set. :grimacing:

dylan-eng: I repro'd locally by snapshotting their index + switching to rerank-v3. I see top-1 flip. Old rerank scores: [0.87, 0.63, 0.59], new rerank scores: [0.45, 0.60, 0.58] — the previously top doc got heavily downweighted.

sarah-ml: That pattern looks like a calibration/norm shift. Quantized embeddings can change dot-product scale; reranker features expect pre-rollout embedding norms. Could be feature mismatch between embed and rerank training.

emma-cs: Customer is asking for rollback or mitigation ASAP, they're seeing production impact on end users.

jordan-ops: Mitigation options: 1) route BrightLedger traffic to rerank-v2/pinned model 2) reindex with stable embedding model 3) adjust reranker scoring threshold. Which is fastest?

dylan-eng: We can push a routing rule to pin BrightLedger -> rerank-v2 within ~10–15m. I'll open the PR and a policy. Will also gather recall delta metrics for them.

maya-cs: Customer tried setting a "rerank_min_score":0.5 param and saw slight improvement for some queries; not a universal fix.

sarah-ml: For longer term: we need to retrain or calibrate reranker on quantized/normalized embeddings or add norm-agnostic features. Short term fallback to rerank-v2 or revert the rerank rollout for affected orgs.

emma-cs: I'll tell the customer we're implementing a routing fallback and will share ETA. Also asking them for a small labeled set of ~50 failing queries to help triage.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: apply routing rule to map org:brightledger -> rerank-v2 (PR #3456), ETA ~12m.

maya-cs: Customer also requested per-day recall delta and top-k change logs. Can eng produce a quick impact report?

dylan-eng: I'm pulling their eval runs and will post numbers + link to logs here in thread once done.

emma-cs: Thanks all — I'll update BrightLedger when the rule is live and keep them in the loop. Leaving thread open until rollback/mitigation confirmed.
